en.headline: HZMB fresh-food clearance to run 24 hours from 1 October
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety will extend operating hours for designated Mainland produce arriving via the bridge from the present 16-hour window, after talks with Mainland authorities and the trade.
body: The Centre for Food Safety of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said that from 12.00am on 1 October, vehicles carrying designated fresh food from the Mainland will be able to enter Hong Kong via the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge at any hour.

The centre said the present window of 16 hours a day, from 1pm to 5am the next day, will be extended to 24 hours after discussions with Mainland authorities and after listening to the trade. Covered categories are frozen and chilled poultry, meat and game, eggs, milk, fresh aquatic products, vegetables and fruit.

A spokesman said the change is intended to give importers more flexibility in scheduling arrivals to match how different food businesses operate. The centre will continue to inspect vehicles at the Hong Kong Port of the bridge, checking import documents, examining consignments and taking samples for testing.
Operating hours and arrangements for fresh food arriving through the Man Kam To Boundary Control Point will stay the same, the spokesman said.

zh.headline: 港珠澳大橋鮮活食品10月1日起全日通關
zh.dek: 食安中心公布，經港珠澳大橋進口指定內地鮮活食品的通關時間由10月1日零晈起由每日16小時延長至全日24小時。
body: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心表示，由10月1日零晈起，運載指定鮮活食品的車輛可於任何時段經港珠澳大橋進入本港。
中心表示，經與內地當局商討及聽取業界意見後，決定把現時每日16小時（下午1晈至翌日上午5晈）的通關時間延長至全日24小時。涵蓋類別包括冷藏和冰鮮家禽、肉類及野味、蛋類、奶類、鮮活水產、蔬菜和水果。
發言人稱，安排旨在讓業界更靈活安排鮮活食品抵港時間，配合不同食物行業的運作。食安中心會繼續在大橋香港口岸檢查進口車輛，核對進口文件、進行實物檢查及抽取樣本作檢測。
發言人補充，經文錦渡口岸進口鮮活食品的通關時間及安排維持不變。
